title: Partial amendment notice (Draft) of Import Health Requirements for processed animal protein feed
description:
Additional provisions have been added to the draft amendment notified in G/SPS/N/KOR/844 (9 April 2026). 

 

The main content of the draft amendment is to allow poultry-derived products produced in countries from which imports into the Republic of Korea are prohibited to be imported into the Republic of Korea, in accordance with the prescribed procedures, provided that they have been rendered. 

 

The newly added provisions specify that, during the rendering process, the products must be treated either with moist heat at a minimum temperature of 56 °C for 30 minutes, or by heating the entire product to a minimum internal temperature of 74 °C, or by a method demonstrated to have an equivalent or greater efficacy.

 

 This measure has been established to ensure a minimum level of safety against highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) in the importation of poultry-derived products, taking into consideration the treatment conditions recommended in Article 10.4.19 of the WOAH Terrestrial Animal Health Code for the importation of poultry-derived products intended for use as animal feed.

title: Draft Order approving certain protective measures relating to certain products of animal origin intended for animal feed and imported from Ukraine
description: The Draft Order establishes the Protective Measures for some animal origin products intended for animal consumption and imported from Ukraine transposing into national legislation the provisions of Directive (EC) 2002/805, including the restrictive measure: of a temporary interdiction or a special authorization regime on import of powdered milk and powdered formula obtained from powdered milk for animal feed, originating from Ukraine; and the obligation of sampling to detect the presence of chloramphenicol for every batch of this type, before market placement. The act aims to protect animal health, ensure a rigorous mechanism for verification of conformities, harmonize the legal framework with European standards, and facilitate international trade.

title: Draft Order of the Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food of Ukraine “On Amendments to the Order of the Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food of Ukraine No. 118 of 12 March 2019” (concerning the Requirements for the Safety and Quality of Milk and Dairy Products)
description:
The draft Order proposes amendments to Order of the Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food of Ukraine of 12 March 2019 No. 118 "On Approval of the Requirements for Safety and Quality of Milk and Dairy Products", in particular with regard to: 

  • establishing specific calendar dates for the mandatory application of criteria to raw milk, replacing the reference to the date of termination or cancellation of martial law, namely 1 January 2029 and 1 January 2028, respectively;
  • adding a definition of the term “milk raw material” and clarifying the terminology in accordance with the legislation;
  • extending the exemption for own consumption to the preparation, processing and storage of dairy products;
  • introducing requirements for demonstrating the representativeness of raw milk samples with regard to fat and protein content, as well as criteria for sample unsuitability and the consequences of determining such unsuitability;
  • supplementing the list of research (testing) methods with reference methods for determining fat and protein content and expanding the list of alternative analytical methods;
  • clarifying the conditions for the use of milk and colostrum that do not meet the established requirements.

The draft Order is aslo notified under the TBT Agreement as regards requirements for materials and articles intended to come into contact with milk and dairy products, as well as identification marking and related information requirements.

title: Draft Order of the Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food of Ukraine  “On Approval of the Requirements for Good Distribution Practice of Veterinary Medicinal Products”
description:
The draft Order provides for the approval of the Requirements for Good Distribution Practice of Veterinary Medicinal Products. These Requirements are mandatory for veterinary medicinal product market operators holding a licence to carry out activities involving the manufacture and import of veterinary medicinal products and their wholesale distribution, as well as for veterinary medicinal product market operators holding a licence to carry out wholesale distribution of veterinary medicinal products, including those operating under special customs regimes, such as free zones or customs warehouses.
The draft Order establishes Good Distribution Practice requirements for veterinary medicinal products regarding:
quality management, including the quality system;
personnel, including personnel training;
premises, equipment, computerized systems, qualification of equipment and validation of processes;
documentation, procedures and record-keeping;
operations, including the approval of suppliers and customers, requirements for the receipt and storage of veterinary medicinal products, the destruction of unsuitable veterinary medicinal products, order picking, supply and export;
handling of complaints, returned and falsified veterinary medicinal products, and the recall of veterinary medicinal products from the market;
activities of third-party contractors;
self-inspections;
transportation of veterinary medicinal products, including those requiring special transportation conditions.

title: Circular amending, supplementing a number of articles of various circulars in the field of agriculture and environment
description:
The draft Circular amends, supplements or abolish a number of regulations in the field of agriculture and environment: 

- Plant production and protection: 

(i) decentralize from the Minister of Agriculture and Environment to the Chair persons of provincial-level People’s Committee in dealing with administrative procedures for the State inspection of imported pesticide quality; 

(ii) abolish the conditions for granting Decision on recognition of plant variety testing bodies, and abolish administrative procedures for granting, re-granting the Decision on recognition of plant variety testing bodies; 

(iii) abolish administrative procedures for self-declaration of plant variety circulation; 

(iv) extend valid duration of Decision on recognition of fertilizer circulation in Viet Nam from five years to ten years; 

(v) simplify administrative procedures for granting Pesticide import License.

- Fisheries: abolish Article 5 of Circular 16/2026/TT-BNNMT to have consistence with the relevant regulations of the revised Law on Fisheries.

- Dyke management: revise scope of application in the light that guidance is only provided to consult with the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment on acceptance of dyke-related activities.

 

The draft Circular aims to promptly implement relevant higher-level legal instruments; reduce and simplify administrative procedures and business investment conditions; promote decentralization; update procedures and forms; reduce processing time and compliance costs; and facilitate production, business and trade activities by organizations and individuals.

title: Decree amending, supplementing a number of articles of various circulars in the field of agriculture and environment
description:
The draft Decree amends, supplements or abolish a number of regulations in the field of plant production and protection:

(i) abolish administrative procedures for re-granting Pesticide import License; 

(ii) abolish fertilizer business conditions, administrative procedures for the State management of imported fertilizer inspection, administrative procedures for re-granting fertilizer manufacturing eligibility certificates when such certificates are lost or damaged;

(iii) abolish conditions for granting Decision on recognition of a plant variety testing body, and administrative procedures for granting, re-granting Decision on recognition of a plant variety testing body; 

(iv) decentralize from the Minister of Agriculture and Environment to the Chair persons of provincial-level People’s Committee in dealing with two administrative procedures for certifying and re-certifying the export fragrant rice which enjoys tax-free import quotas; 

(v) abolish conditions for re-issuing representative service Certificates for plant variety right;

(vi) reduce time to carry out some administrative procedures. At the same time, this draft Decree regulates a transition provision related to plant variety testing. 

 

The draft Decree aims to reduce, simplify administrative procedures, business investment conditions, decentralization; update processes and forms.

title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1751 of 20 July 2026 correcting Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/154 as regards transitional measures
description:
This corrigendum corrects an error in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/154 of 23 January 2026 concerning the authorisation of sepiolitic clay as a feed additive for all animal species other than ruminants for milk production or reproduction, weaned piglets of porcine species, porcine species for fattening, salmonids and chickens for fattening and amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/263 as regards the terms of the authorisation of sepiolitic clay as a feed additive for salmonids and chickens for fattening (Text with EEA relevance), notified on 5 February 2026. 

 

Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/154 erroneously omitted to provide for the usual transitional measures, as regards all animal species other than ruminants for milk production or reproduction, weaned piglets of porcine species, porcine species for fattening, salmonids and chickens for fattening, allowing interested parties to prepare themselves to meet the new requirements resulting from the authorisation. Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/154 is therefore corrected accordingly by this Act, which applies retroactively from the date of entry into force of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/154 (15 February 2026).

title: Regulation on Plant Quarantine
description:
It was announced that the revised Plant Quarantine Regulation was published on 6 May 2026, and the SPS notification was published with the symbol G/SPS/N/TUR/23/Rev.1/Add.2. 

In addition, the English text of the Plant Quarantine Regulation, which was published on 6 May 2026 and entered into force on 4 August 2026, was announced with the symbol G/SPS/N/TUR/23/Rev.1/Add.4, along with the SPS notification. 

With the entry into force of the Regulation on 4 August 2026, paragraph 13 of Article 8 of the Regulation was titled "Import Control" and The provision states that:

“For plants and plant products listed in Annex-4 for which pest-free area information relating to the production site is required, the list of areas designated as free from the relevant pest by the national plant protection organisation in the country of origin is notified in advance in accordance with the relevant ISPMs. In the event of a change in the phytosanitary status of the areas reported as free from the pest, the national plant protection organization shall submit an updated list of such areas.”

In this context, for the import of plants and plant products listed in Annex 4 for which information on pest-free areas related to the production area is required, the list of areas determined by the country of origin’s National Plant Protection Organization to be free from the relevant pest must be officially notified in advance to our country’s National Plant Protection Organization.

Official controls of the relevant shipments will not be initiated until the said free area lists are officially notified to our country by the National Plant Protection Organization of the country of origin. As stated in subparagraph (b) of paragraph 1 of Article 16 of the Regulation, 20 days are given to complete the deficiencies in the documents. If the deficiencies cannot be completed within this period, the procedures for the return of the shipments to the exporting country will be initiated.

title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2070 of 17 September 2026 correcting Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/164 as regards 2-chloroethanol
description:
This corrigendum corrects an error in the Annex of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/164 of 26 January 2026 concerning the renewal of the authorisation of an aqueous solution of choline chloride and a preparation of choline chloride as feed additives for all animal species and repealing Implementing Regulation (EU) No 795/2013 (Text with EEA relevance), notified on 4 February 2026. In this Annex, the level of 2-chloroethanol was incorrectly expressed. The level expressed in the characterisation of the active substance corresponded to the level of 2-chloroethanol in the additives concerned but not to the level in the active substance. In addition, the level should not refer to 2-chloroethanol but to the sum of ethylene oxide and 2-chloroethanol expressed as ethylene oxide. 

 

To preserve the legitimate expectations of feed business operators, the Regulation applies retroactively and enters into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.

title: Draft Order of the Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food of Ukraine "On Amendments to the Order of the Ministry for Development of Economy, Trade and Agriculture of Ukraine No. 741 of 12 April 2021" (concerning Hygienic Requirements for the production and circulation of natural mineral water and spring water)
description:
The draft Order provides for amendments to the Hygienic Requirements for the Production and Circulation of Natural Mineral Waters and Spring Waters, approved by Order of the Ministry for Development of Economy, Trade and Agriculture of Ukraine No. 741 of 12 April 2021, notified in documents G/SPS/N/UKR/156 and G/SPS/N/UKR/156/Add.1.

The draft Order establishes conditions for the treatment of natural mineral waters and spring waters with ozone-enriched air and activated alumina to ensure the safety of the treatment processes and prevent changes to the essential characteristics of the waters.

It sets requirements for the use of ozone-enriched air for the removal of compounds of iron, manganese, sulphur and arsenic, and for the use of activated alumina for the removal of excess fluoride compounds, including requirements concerning its initialisation, regeneration and quality control.

The draft Order also establishes requirements concerning the permissible margins of error and the accuracy of safety testing of treated natural mineral waters and spring waters, the application of appropriate production and hygiene practices and the monitoring of critical stages of the treatment process. It also establishes labelling requirements for treated waters indicating the adsorption method used.

The draft Order has been developed based on the provisions of Commission Directive 2003/40/EC and Commission Regulation (EU) No 115/2010. 

The draft Order is also notified under the TBT Agreement.

title: Draft Circular of the Minister of Agriculture and Environment on Management of Livestock Breeds and Livestock Breed Products
description:
The Draft Circular consolidates and updates Viet Nam's rules on the management of livestock breeds and livestock breed products. It covers the international exchange of rare and precious animal genetic resources; the export or international exchange of livestock breeds and livestock breed products included in the List of livestock breeds prohibited from export; the List of livestock breeds requiring conservation; and the List of livestock breeds prohibited from export.

It also prescribes requirements and procedures for testing and recognition of testing results for livestock lines and breeds; recognition of new livestock lines and breeds; minimum quality levels for livestock breeds; and certificates of training in artificial insemination and embryo transfer techniques. Applications may be submitted in person, by post or electronically, with specified processing time limits and responsibilities for updating the national livestock database.

The Draft Circular maintains and standardizes four administrative procedures, clarifies central and provincial competence, reduces or simplifies processing requirements, and strengthens traceability, electronic processing and post-market control. title: Draft Order of the Ministry of Health of Ukraine “On Approval of the Criteria for Classifying Drinking Water as Natural Mineral Water and the Safety Requirements for Natural Mineral Waters and Spring Waters"
description:
The draft Order provides for the approval of the Criteria for classifying drinking water as natural mineral water and the Safety Requirements for natural mineral waters and spring waters.

The Criteria establish geological, hydrogeological, physical, chemical, physico-chemical and microbiological requirements for classifying drinking water as natural mineral water. These include requirements concerning underground origin, protection from contamination, microbiological safety, stability of composition, temperature and other essential characteristics within natural variations. They also specify the natural characteristics of the water, including mineral substances, trace elements or other constituents, and define the term “normal total microbial count”.

The Criteria also establish maximum levels for certain naturally occurring constituents that may pose a risk to human health and provide for pharmacological, physiological and clinical studies where necessary.

The Safety Requirements set out microbiological safety requirements for natural mineral waters and spring waters, including maximum levels for the total microbial count and requirements concerning the absence of parasites and pathogenic microorganisms. They also establish maximum permissible levels of naturally occurring constituents in natural mineral waters and maximum permissible levels of residues resulting from the treatment of natural mineral waters and spring waters with ozone-enriched air.

title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1811 of 24 July 2026 concerning the authorisation of eugenol and trans-anethole as feed additives for poultry and ornamental birds and the renewal of the authorisation of trans-anethole produced by chemical synthesis as a feed additive for ornamental birds, and amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1452 (Text with EEA relevance)
description:
The act further to the positive scientific assessment conducted by the European Food Safety Authority: 

  • Authorises for the first time for a period of 10 years the following feed additives: 
    • Eugenol by the extraction from dried clove leaves or clove leaf oil (Eugenia caryophyllata Thunberg) for poultry and ornamental birds;
    • Trans-anethole produced by chemical synthesis for poultry;
    • Trans-anethole produced from leaves or fruit of star anise (Illicium verum Hook.f) for poultry and ornamental birds.

        The terms of the authorisation are detailed in the Annex to the Act.

  • Renews trans-anethole produced by chemical synthesis for ornamental birds. This additive was authorised for a period of 10 years. The application for the authorisation of trans-anethole produced by chemical synthesis for ornamental birds should be treated as an application for renewal of the authorisation granted by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1452. The terms of the renewal are detailed in the Annex to the Act. A transitional period is included for the interested parties to meet the new authorisation’s requirements.
  • Modifies the authorisation of trans-anethole from pine oil to set a maximum content. Trans-anethole produced from pine oil authorised for ornamental birds by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1452 should be authorised with a maximum content as it has the same specifications in terms of composition as the trans-anethole produced by chemical synthesis that is going to be renewed with a maximum content due to the zootechnical effects. The terms of the modification are detailed in the Annex to the Act. A transitional period is included for the interested parties to meet the new authorisation’s requirements. 

All the additives belong to the category “sensory additives” and the functional group “compounds”.

title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1859 of 29 July 2026 concerning the renewal of the authorisation of a preparation of taurine as a feed additive for Canidae, Felidae, Mustelidae, carnivorous finfish and other aquatic carnivorous species and repealing Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/722 (Text with EEA relevance)
description: The preparation of Taurine covered by the Act was authorised for 10 years as feed additive for Canidae, Felidae, Mustelidae and carnivorous fish by Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/722 in the additive category ‘nutritional additives’ and in the functional group ‘vitamins, pro-vitamins and chemically well-defined substances having similar effect’. An application was submitted for the renewal of the authorisation of this preparation in accordance with article 14 of Regulation (EC) No 1831/2003. Based on the favourable conclusions of a scientific assessment of the dossier submitted by the applicant, conducted by the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA), the authorisation of this preparation as a feed additive for Canidae, Felidae, Mustelidae, carnivorous finfish and other aquatic carnivorous species a is renewed under certain conditions detailed in the Annex to the Act. description: The notified document establishes phytosanitary requirements for the importation of bare-rooted coffee plants originating in Guatemala.1. The shipment must be accompanied by an official phytosanitary certificate, which certifies that the plants have been officially inspected by the national plant protection organization (NPPO) of the country of origin, and indicates under "Additional declaration" that the shipment comes from a crop inspected during the growth period at appropriate times for the detection of pests and has been found free of: Meloidogyne paranaensis, Pseudococcus elisae, Dysmicoccus neobrevipes;2. The shipment will be subject to a phytosanitary inspection and sampling for phytosanitary diagnosis at the agricultural quarantine post upon entry into the country.Shipments will be subject to phytosanitary checks by plant quarantine inspectors from the Institute for Agricultural and Livestock Protection and Health, who will verify compliance with the phytosanitary requirements and decide whether or not to authorize importation, on the basis of the accompanying documents.

title: Draft Law of Ukraine "On Biocidal Products"
description:
The draft Law of Ukraine “On Biocidal Products” is intended to regulate legal relations concerning the approval of active substances used in biocidal products, the state registration, production, making available on the market, placing on the market and safe use of biocidal products and treated articles.  It also defines the rights and obligations of legal entities and individuals, as well as the powers of state authorities and their officials in the field of biocidal products.

Specifically, the draft Law:

  • designates an authorized state entity to conduct the assessment of materials concerning the approval, renewal or review of approval of active substances, prepare expert conclusions on the approval, renewal or review of approval of active substances, and prepare expert conclusions on the possibility of state registration of biocidal products under a simplified procedure;
  • establishes the procedure and criteria for authorizing such entity, the duration of its authorization and the procedure for withdrawal of the authorization, as well as the procedure for determining the fees for the relevant services;
  • establishes requirements for laboratories conducting laboratory testing of active substances for the preparation of active substance dossiers, including accreditation requirements;
  • provides for the establishment of the State Register of Biocidal Products, which is to become operational on 1 January 2030, through the modernization of the existing State Register of Disinfectants. The draft Law also stipulates that all registrations of disinfectants that are valid as of the date of entry into force of this Law shall remain valid until their expiry.

objectivesFreeText: On 6 May 2021, EFSA published an updated safety assessment for E 171. According to this, E 171 is no longer considered safe for use as a food additive. The EFSA safety assessment found that titanium dioxide is absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract to a very low extent, but takes a long time to be excreted from the body. In addition, titanium dioxide has the potential to accumulate in tissues. After evaluation of the available data, the suspicion of a mutagenic effect of titanium dioxide could not be invalidated. Based on this safety assessment, Switzerland decided that this additive should no longer be used in food.

title: The draft Order of the Ministry of Health of Ukraine “On Approval of the Requirements for the Composition of Food for Special Medical Purposes”
description:
The draft Order provides for the approval of mandatory requirements for the composition of food for special medical purposes.

The draft Requirements classify food for special medical purposes into three categories: nutritionally complete food with a standard nutrient formulation; nutritionally complete food with a nutrient-adapted formulation specific for a disease, disorder or medical condition; and nutritionally incomplete food with a standard or nutrient-adapted formulation, which is not suitable to be used as the sole source of nourishment. Nutritionally complete food may constitute the sole source of nourishment or may be used as a partial replacement or supplement to the patient’s diet.

The draft Requirements define the substances that may be used in the manufacture of food for special medical purposes and establish minimum and maximum levels of vitamins and minerals for products developed for infants and for products other than those developed for infants. They also set requirements concerning pesticide residues in products intended for infants and young children, and requirements for information on food, labelling, presentation and advertising.
